target_customer: Consumers and doctors in India buying smartphone-read at-home test kits such as urine kidney and UTI cards
problem: Routine lab tests are slow and inaccessible in India; Neodocs lets a user collect a sample, photograph a test card and get results instantly.
business_model: Direct-to-consumer and doctor-channel sales of test cards and kits read by a smartphone app

founders.name: Nikunj Malpani
founders.background_notes: Former consultant at Bain per the YC page.

founders.name: Pratik Lodha
founders.background_notes: YC page: built AI and ML models for leading US banks.

founders.name: Anurag Meena
founders.background_notes: Medical entrepreneur per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Colorimetric reading of test strips by phone cameras under varied lighting needs computer vision plus chemistry and device regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: Test card chemistry, image data and clinical validation are harder to replicate than the app, but smartphone urinalysis rivals already held FDA clearances.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquirer found; competitors such as Healthy.io, Scanwell and Inui held FDA clearances in the US per a 360Dx article, and Neodocs kept selling in India.

market_need_then: Limited access to routine diagnostics in India and growth of at-home testing after the pandemic; the company reports over 200,000 test cards sold by 2024.

identity.visual_style: e-commerce style product pages with press logos and reviews
identity.voice_and_tone: simple and trust-focused: 'Accurate, accessible point-of-care testing for everyone'

rebrands.why: Capitalization difference only across sources; no reason given

brand_strength.rationale: Indian startup press coverage and a Dell startup challenge win (YourStory 2023 headline) but no brand-specific assets or community found.

outcome_analysis: Neodocs raised a pre-seed in August 2021 from YC, 9Unicorns and Titan Capital, then a roughly 2 million dollar seed in February 2024 led by Omidyar Network India. It reports 200,000 test cards sold and over 4,000 doctors, and its store was live in 2026. No Series A was found, and the long gap between rounds means growth has been slow or capital-light.
notes: Seed of about 16.6 crore rupees (2M dollars) reported by Business Standard, Inc42 and YourStory (seen in search results; YourStory pages returned 403 on fetch). Pre-seed amount not found; the 2021 round is known from headline and investors only. Aggregator total of 2.48M is unverified. Competitor search found Healthy.io, Vessel, Vivoo (CB Insights, undated) and Scanwell and Inui (360Dx, undated), so none can be placed at 2021 and the list is left empty. Inc42 shows a 6 percent headcount drop over 90 days, not a confirmed layoff. YourStory 2021 snippet describes Pratik Lodha as ex-PwC, conflicting with the YC page; not recorded.
